text: Your heart would like a word.
Omega-3s are healthy fats found in fatty fish. They support your heart, and may help your joints.
Eat fatty fish like salmon or sardines twice a week, and you may not need a supplement.
If you don't, fish oil or algae oil fills the gap. Take it with a meal.
You can start, but if you're on blood thinners or have a heart condition, check with your doctor first. Save this.
